name: Asleep
description: When asleep in combat, one is unable to act on their turn. However, they will wake upon receiving damage.

name: Bleeding
description: When bleeding in combat, one is less likely to deal a critical hit and takes damage on every turn.

name: Blind
description: When blinded in combat, one is more likely to miss their attacks against an opponent.

name: Burning
description: When burning in combat, one takes damage on every turn and has their attack and magic stats lowered.

name: Cursed
description: When cursed in combat, one takes moderate damage on every turn.

name: Drenched
description: When drenched in combat, one may slip and fall.

name: Frog
description: When afflicted with this curse, Ward is disabled.

name: Frozen
description: When frozen in combat, one may temporarily be unable to act on their turn.

name: Lulled
description: When lulled in combat, one may be too enamored to attack their opponent.

name: Morrigan's Curse
description: When afflicted with this curse, one may become a monster after 3 turns.

name: Paralyzed
description: When paralyzed in combat, one may seldomly be unable to act on their turn.

name: Poisoned
description: When afflicted with poison in combat, one takes damage on every turn.

name: Rot
description: When afflicted with rot in combat, one takes damage on every turn and has their magical and physical defense stats lowered.

name: Stunned
description: When stunned in combat, one may not be able to act on their turn.

name: Confused
description: When afflicted with confusion in combat, one may not perform the actions they intended.

name: Blight
description: When afflicted with blight in combat, one takes damage on every turn and may temporarily be unable to act on their turn.

name: Petrified
description: When petrified in combat, one is unable to act on their turn.

name: Starstruck
description: When starstruck, one will take considerable damage if they do not heal after a countdown.

name: Windswept
description: When windswept in combat, one has their ability to perform a critical hit greatly decreased.

name: Doom
description: When afflicted with doom in combat, one will find certain doom after some time.

name: Stasis
description: When frozen in time, one is unable to act on their turn.

name: Toxic
description: When afflicted with toxic in combat, one takes moderate damage on every turn.

name: Bloodshift
description: When afflicted with bloodshift, it will not be possible to heal or revive oneself.

name: Curse of Sekhmet
description: When afflicted with this curse, it will not be possible to heal or revive oneself. Additionally, one will take damage each turn.
